name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail termini and a through station with a pedestrian underpass.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.9.3 (formerly Ultimate Metro) adds tram-based light rail stations: a surface terminus, an underground terminus and a through station with a pedestrian underpass. Stations use two 80m platforms and ordinary electric tramtrack connections. The through station offers street access at the front, middle and rear of both platforms. The surface terminus includes a compact scissors crossover and a landscaped head plaza. The underground terminus uses native underground station assets and street-level pedestrian access. Station type, length and platform count are not configurable yet. This rename preserves the internal mod ID and all station resources for existing saves; no station rebuilding is required. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
